title: Skill Registry And Tool Diagnostics Full React Parity And Jinja Removal

specify.notes: Created the active Spec 042 specification from the generated roadmap prompt. Scope covers full React parity and Jinja removal for skill package, package-version, tenant grant, installation, credential, smoke-test, readiness, binding eligibility, audit timeline, stale conflict, available-version, and SkillExecutionGateway diagnostics workflows.

auto_clarifications: Uploaded manifest content takes precedence over pasted manifest content, with selected source recorded in safe audit evidence.
Raw manifest text is not re-rendered after submission; only safe summaries, metadata, findings, fingerprints, revision tokens, and artifact references may appear.
Old package, version, grant, installation, configure, and diagnostics routes redirect to React with safe ids, conflict state, filters, and return intent preserved.
Smoke-test and connector diagnostic refresh actions are explicit user actions and remain mocked-safe in local/CI validation.
Tenant users see authorized safe availability/readiness/binding summaries while platform-only mutation controls remain hidden and denied.
Process-local service limits render as safe readiness or unavailable states with remediation and rollback guidance.

plan.notes: Planned skill registry and SkillExecutionGateway diagnostics React parity by extending Spec 032 contracts, adding stable React child routes and legacy redirect mappings for packages, versions, grants, available versions, installations, credentials, smoke tests, eligibility, audit, and diagnostics; preserving backend-owned authorization/redaction; and blocking template deletion until route/scanner/QA/Playwright evidence passes.
